hero.heading: Subscribe to Program Partner.
hero.subhead_founding: $299 a year per program, our founding price, kept every year you renew.
hero.subhead_standard: $349 a year per program, with every feature included.

checkout.heading: Pay online
checkout.body: Check out on Stripe's secure page. You'll get a receipt by email, and your subscription renews once a year until you cancel.
checkout.fallback_button: Ask us to set up your subscription
checkout.terms_before: By subscribing you agree to our
checkout.terms_after: . Cancel any time; you keep access through the year you paid for.

purchase_order.heading: Paying by purchase order or check?
purchase_order.body: Tell us about your program and who handles purchasing. We'll send a quote, then an invoice due in 30 days, and a W-9. Your program can start as soon as the invoice is sent.
purchase_order.founding_note: A quote we send by June 30, 2027 keeps the founding price.

items.title: You subscribe
items.body: Online, or with a purchase order. Either way you'll have a receipt or an invoice for your records.

items.title: We set up your program
items.body: We'll email you within one business day to schedule guided setup, and we can import your records for you.

items.title: You invite your people
items.body: Add your staff and booster officers, then give families their registration codes.

thanks.heading: You're subscribed.
thanks.body: Thank you. Your receipt is on its way from Stripe. We'll email you within one business day to schedule your guided setup.
